title: Chemical Engineering Principles-I
evidence_note: Outline file CHE-103.md excluded - it contains Principles-II content (energy balances, semester 3) and duplicates CHE-222. Mapped from CLOs only.

mapped.evidence: Comprehend the basic concepts of chemical engineering principles and relate them to chemical engineering calculations.
Extend the concepts of process principles to solve material balance problems for single and multiple units.
Programming concepts: variables, data types, input and output, conditionals and loops, and Python libraries. Labs cover programming fundamentals and MS Excel.
Introduction to statistics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning using Python; introduction to regression and classification tasks.
CLO-4: Demonstrate the ethical and legal considerations in use of ICT platform tools; outline lists 'Issues of ethics in data and AI'.
CLO-5: To demonstrate responsible conduct while working individually as well as in team.

title: Functional English
evidence_note: Language course, but it carries the programme's communication attribute (maps to PLO 9). Mapped secondary only - it teaches general rather than technical communication.

mapped.evidence: Produce clear, concise, and professional written documents and deliver effective public speeches tailored to various audiences and purposes.

unmapped.label: general language proficiency
unmapped.evidence: Develop proficiency in English language usage - appropriate word choices, grammar, and sentence structure.

mapped.evidence: Relate the use of differentiation and integration of single variable functions and implement them to find the area and volume applicable to different engineering problems; series and limit comparison tests.
